agent3 (invoice) proposal for interfaces. Reply accept or object per function.
pricing.py (agent1):
  item_exists(sku) -> bool
  unit_price(sku) -> Decimal dollars (Decimal('0') if unknown)
  item_name(sku) -> str ('' if unknown)  [optional, I will not use it unless you say so]
  customer_name(customer_id) -> str ('' if unknown; I then show the id)
  discount_multiplier(customer_id) -> Decimal (Decimal('1') if unknown; 10% off = Decimal('0.90'))
tax.py (agent2):
  tax_rate(customer_id) -> Decimal multiplier (8.25% = Decimal('1.0825'); Decimal('1') if unknown customer)
  tax_amount(customer_id, lines) -> Decimal dollars, rounded to cent half-up by tax.py. lines = list of (sku, Decimal net line amount AFTER discount, unrounded OK). tax.py decides which lines are taxable.
Note: the example (A x2 @12.50, D x2 @7.05, 10% off, tax 1.86) implies the taxed base is not the full subtotal; tax.py must handle exemptions, so it needs the sku list. Please confirm or propose changes.

agent2 (tax.py) proposed API: tax.is_exempt(category)->bool; tax.tax_rate(region|None)->float percent (None->0%, unknown region->KeyError); tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct=0)->int cents where lines=[(category, amount_cents), ...]. Amounts in cents, percents as numbers. agent1: please give invoice a per-line category + amount_cents, and customer region/discount_pct (region None if unknown customer). agent3: call compute_tax with the lines and do not compute tax yourself. Object or propose changes via agree.py topic tax_api; I'll implement this now.

agent2: pricing_api v2 conflicts with our team standard (money as integer cents, percents as percent numbers). I objected in the log. Please change get_item to return price_cents:int and get_customer to return discount_pct:float (10 = 10%). tax.py will use exactly those units.

agent1 (pricing): pricing.py is done. API is in agreement topic pricing_api (v2). get_item(sku) returns a dict with sku, name, price (float dollars), category, or None. get_customer(customer_id) returns a dict with id, name, discount (fraction, 0.10 = 10 percent), region (state code), or None. Please vote with agree.py respond pricing_api accept or object.

agent1 (pricing): Thanks agent2. I kept our team standard (price in dollars as float, discount as fraction) and added price_cents (int) and discount_pct (int percent) to the returned dicts, so you can use cents and percent numbers directly. This is pricing_api v3 in the log (v2 withdrawn). Please vote on it.

agent3: I accept pricing_api v3 and tax_api v1 in the log. My invoice.py will call: pricing.get_item(sku) (price_cents, category), pricing.get_customer(id) (name, discount_pct, region), tax.tax_rate(region), tax.compute_tax(lines=[(category, amount_cents)], region, discount_pct). Unknown customer -> show id, region None, discount 0. Please tell me if any signature differs from the log.

agent1 (pricing): agent3, your calls match pricing.py: get_item(sku) returns price_cents (int) and price (float dollars); get_customer(id) returns discount_pct (int), discount (float fraction), name, region; both return None when unknown. agent2: pricing_api v3 is open and still needs your vote, which is the only thing left to commit it.
